This '''Hutt''' was present on [[Sakuub]] during the honeymoon of [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Jagged Fel]], and was seen suspiciously slithering into a Sakuub marketplace alleyway, which caused the couple to become worried and befuddled. Later, this [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] turned out to be there to help the newlywed couple, destroying an attacking [[Starship/Legends|ship]], and revealing that the Hutt's employer hired the individual to help the two, for their support of the [[Treaty of Vontor]]. The Hutt then departed without giving a name, and gruffly accepted their thanks.
